αἰθομένοιο: αἴθω — burn, blaze; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with πυρός: ’blazing’
αὐτάρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
γίγνωσκε: γιγνώσκω — come to know, recognise; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐγίγνωσκε)
γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
γενεὴ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. nom. sg.
γενεὴν: γενεή — generation, race; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
δέρμα: δέρμα — skin, hide; neut. acc. sg.
δαήμεναι: δάω — learn, find out (aor. pass. ἐδάην); aor. 2 pass. inf., epic -ήμεναι (= Attic δαῆναι)
δειδιότα: δείδω — fear; perf. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic δεδιότα): ’frightened’
δεκάτη: δέκατος — tenth; fem. nom. sg. (with ἠώς, ’the tenth dawn’)
διωνύσοιο: Διώνυσος — Dionysus, god of wine; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
εἷσε: ἵζω — make sit, set, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.: ’set, seated, stationed’
εὐρείης: εὐρύς — wide, broad; fem. gen. sg., epic (= Attic εὐρείας)
εὐρείῃ: εὐρύς — broad, wide; fem. dat. sg., epic -είῃ (= Attic -είᾳ)
εὔχομαι: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow, boast, pray; pres. 1 sg.: ’I declare myself (to be)’
ζώοντες: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ζῶντες)
θέεν: θέω — run; impf. 3 sg., epic uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ἔθει): ’ran’
θυμοφθόρα: θυμοφθόρος — heart-destroying, deadly (of drugs); neut. acc. pl.
κατέλειπον: καταλείπω — leave behind, abandon; impf. 1 sg. (or 3 pl.): ’I was leaving, I left’
κατέπεφνε: πέφνω (defective verb) — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg., augmented and reduplicated (κατ-έ-πεφν-ε): ‘killed’
κατέπεφνεν: πέφνω (defective, found only in the aorist) — slay, kill; redupl. aor. 3 sg. of the compound κατα-πέφνω: ’slew’
κατέρυκε: κατερύκω — hold back, detain; pres. imper. 2 sg. (with μή: ’stop holding back’) · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic κατήρυκε): ’was holding back, tried to hold back’
καταθνητῶν: καταθνητός — mortal, subject to death; masc. gen. pl. (καταθνητῶν ἀνθρώπων ’of mortal men’), epic by-form of θνητός
κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
κυδαλίμοισι: κυδάλιμος — glorious, renowned; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
κόλπῳ: κόλπος — bosom, fold of a garment; masc. dat. sg.
μένει: μένω — stay, remain, wait; pres. 3 sg.
μέσση: μέσος — middle; fem. nom. sg., epic doubled-σ (= Attic μέση): ’in her middle’
μήσατο: μήδομαι — devise, contrive, plan; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐμήσατο)
μαχοίμην: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. opt. 1 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that I might fight’ · also pres. opt. 1 sg., potential with κε: ’I would fight’ (καί κε … μαχοίμην)
μειλιχίοισι: μειλίχιος — soothing, gentle, winning; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μυχῷ: μυχός — innermost part, corner, recess; masc. dat. sg.
ξεινήϊα: ξεινήϊος — of a guest-friend, hospitable; neut. acc. pl., epic (= Attic ξένια): ’guest-gifts’ with δῶρα
ξεῖνοι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. pl.
πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’was sending’
πατρώϊοι: πατρώϊος — of one’s father, paternal; masc. nom. pl., epic (= Attic πατρῷοι)
πείραθ: πεῖραρ — limit, end, boundary; neut. acc. pl., elided (πείραθ’ = πείραθα)
πεῖθ: πείθω — persuade; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (πεῖθ’ = πεῖθε)
πομπῇ: πομπή — convoy, escort, safe conduct; fem. dat. sg.
πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν)
πόρῃ: πόρω (aor. ἔπορον) — give, grant; aor. subj. 3 sg., prospective in a main clause (= Attic πόρῃ): ’may grant, will grant’
ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg.
τηλεθόωσα: τηλεθάω — flourish, bloom luxuriantly; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg., diectasis (uncontracted, stretched vowel)
τρία: τρεῖς, τρία — three; neut. nom./acc. pl.
τύπτε: τύπτω — strike, beat; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔτυπτε): ’kept beating’
φέριστε: φέρτατος — best, bravest; vocative superl., masc. voc. sg.
φαεινόν: φαεινός — shining, bright; adj., neut. acc. sg.
φύει: φύω — bring forth, make grow; pres. 3 sg., transitive
φῶτας: φώς — man, warrior, mortal; masc. acc. pl.
χέει: χέω — pour, pour out; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic χεῖ)
χρυσήνιος: χρυσήνιος — with golden reins; masc./fem. adj., nom. sg., epithet of Ares
χρύσεον: χρύσεος — golden; adj., neut. acc. sg., uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῦν) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅρμον: ’golden’ (ὅρμον … χρύσεον)
ἀγαθὰ: ἀγαθός — good; neut. acc. pl. ’good things’
ἀπώλετο: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid. perish, be lost; aor. 3 sg. mid.
ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; neut. gen. pl.: ’of all (ills)’ · also masc. gen. pl., in comparison: ’of all (mortals)’ · also gen. pl. with a noun: ’of all (men)’
ἐδάμασσε: δαμάζω — overpower, subdue, kill; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ- (= Attic ἐδάμασε)
ἐθελούσῃ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. dat. sg.: ’unwilling’ (οὐκ ἐθελούσῃ) · also without a negative: ’willing’ (οὐκ ἐθέλων ἐθελούσῃ ’he unwilling, she willing’)
ἐμοῖσι: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic ἐμοῖς)
ἐπέτελλεν: ἐπιτέλλω — command, charge, enjoin; impf. 3 sg.: ‘gave command’
ἐρέεινε: ἐρεείνω — question, ask; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’questioned, was questioning’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’question!’ (μηδ’ ἐρέεινε ’and do not question’)
ἐρεείνεις: ἐρεείνω — ask, question (epic, from ἔρομαι); pres. 2 sg.
ἐρύξας: ἐρύκω — keep, hold back, detain; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἔαρος: ἔαρ — spring; neut. gen. sg. (= Attic ἦρος)
ἔδουσιν: ἐσθίω — eat; pres. 3 pl., from the epic present ἔδω (= Attic ἐσθίουσι)
ἔκτα: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 sg., by-form ἔκτα (root aorist)
ἠνώγειν: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; plupf. 3 sg. in -ειν, epic variant (= ἠνώγει, often labelled impf.), serving as simple past: ’he bade’
ἤματ: ἦμαρ — day; neut. acc. pl. ἤματα, elided ἤματ’ before a vowel: ’(for) days’
ἥμισυ: ἥμισυς — half; neut. acc. sg., used as a noun: ’half’
ἴσασιν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl. (pres. force), ν-movable: ’they know’
ἵκηαι: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive, reach; aor. subj. 2 sg. mid.: ’you may reach’
ἷξε: ἵκω (root aor. ἷξον) — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 sg.: ‘he reached’
ὀδύσαντο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry with, hate (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ὠδύσαντο)
ὀλέθρου: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin; masc. gen. sg., depending on πείρατα: ’of destruction’
ὑπεδέξατο: ὑποδέχομαι — receive, welcome; aor. 3 sg. mid. (augment inside the compound)
ὤπασαν: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, grant; aor. 3 pl., augmented (ὀπάζω, aor. ὤπασα), + dat. of the recipient
ὥρη: ὥρα (Ionic ὥρη) — season, the right time, hour; fem. nom. sg. (Ionic η = Attic ᾱ): ’it is time (for)’
ᾔτεε: αἰτέω — ask, ask for, request; impf. 3 sg., uncontracted
